hook.name: DEPHIHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/token pools implementing a block-decaying buy tax (starts at 99%, decays to 10% over ~445 blocks) and a constant 10% sell tax; collected fees are converted to ETH and distributed 40/40/20 between the token contract, a charity address, and a protocol address. Exact-output swaps and post-deployment liquidity additions are blocked.
